pretrained.reason: Preserve the original Large architecture; measure T4 capability before matched fresh training

bounded_selection_study.tie_policy: Prefer full features, then weight closest to0.5, then pilot, then lower XGB weight

gpu_budget.accounting: Conservative sum of two assigned workers active wall times; not a claim about Kaggle official T4x2 charging.
gpu_budget.throughput_decision_uses: train-only timing and memory; no model-quality evaluation
gpu_budget.maximum_epochs_reason: Six matched epochs fit the conservative assigned-worker budget with setup, selection, checkpoint, calibration, frozen evaluation and failure reserve; no validation score was used to set the cap.

temperature_fit.optimization: Deterministic golden-section search in log-temperature with identity and bounds retained; 96 iterations.

threshold_fit.objective: Maximum both-class macro F1; ties prefer threshold closest to0.5, then lower threshold.

abstention.confidence_policy: Probability assigned to threshold-selected label; accept when confidence>=frozen cutoff.
abstention.objective: Maximum coverage meeting both targets; if infeasible, best observed accuracy with required coverage, then maximum coverage. Calibration fit is not held-out evidence.
